title: Fast Matrix Multiplication in fp8: Certified Coefficient Optimization and Measured Error
abstract: arXiv:2609.26077v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A Strassen-type algorithm has many realizations with the same exact product and multiplication count yet different fp8 error because basis changes reshape coefficient geometry, posing the question of which to run. No current account settles this: classical stability controls worst-case $\ell_1$ growth, not the expected-error magnitude, and the Dumas--Pernet--Sedoglavic optimizer could only be called probably optimal, its global optimality unproved. To settle this, we attach to each realization a coefficient functional $\Phi$, a scalar summary of its coefficient geometry, which we minimize over the change-of-basis orbit. This Kempf--Ness problem on a Hadamard manifold lets us certify the global $\Phi$ optimum rather than merely search for it: an exact moment-map zero fixes $\Phi_{\min} = 200/9$, and de Groote's classification extends that optimality to every exact real rank-7 $2\times2$ decomposition. translated_title: fp8中的快速矩阵乘法：可认证的系数优化与实测误差
translated_abstract: Strassen型算法存在多种实现方式，它们具有相同的精确乘积和相同的乘法次数，但由于基变换会重塑系数几何结构，它们在fp8精度下的误差各不相同，由此引出了应当运行哪一种实现的问题。目前没有任何理论能解决这一问题：经典的稳定性分析只控制最坏情况下的 ℓ₁ 增长，而非期望误差的大小；此外，Dumas–Pernet–Sedoglavic 优化器此前只能被称为“大概率最优”，其全局最优性并未得到证明。为了解决这一问题，我们为每种实现附加一个系数泛函 Φ——即对其系数几何结构的标量化概括——并在换基轨道上对其进行最小化。这个 Hadamard 流形上的 Kempf–Ness 问题使我们能够认证全局 Φ 最优解，而不仅仅是搜索它：一个精确的矩映射零点确定了 Φ_min = 200/9，而 de Groote 的分类将该最优性扩展到每一个精确的实数秩-7 2×2 分解。
tldr: 该论文提出用系数泛函 Φ 刻画 Strassen 型算法的系数几何结构，并通过 Hadamard 流形上的 Kempf–Ness 理论首次认证了其在换基轨道上的全局最优解（Φ_min = 200/9），从而确定 fp8 精度下误差最小的 2×2 矩阵乘法实现。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a coefficient functional Φ capturing the coefficient geometry of Strassen-type algorithms, and certifies—via Kempf–Ness theory on a Hadamard manifold—its global optimum (Φ_min = 200/9) over the change-of-basis orbit, thereby identifying the fp8 error-minimal realization of 2×2 matrix multiplication.
